external_deps: vLLM via Docker with NVIDIA Container Toolkit (GPU)

review.tagline: Converts PDFs, Office files and images to markdown, JSON, HTML or chunks
review.summary: Marker is a Python library and CLI that converts PDF, image, PPTX, DOCX, XLSX, HTML and EPUB files to markdown, JSON, HTML or chunks, handling tables, equations, code blocks and image extraction. Layout, OCR and table recognition run through a surya VLM served by a local vLLM (Docker, NVIDIA) or llama.cpp server that starts automatically. An optional --use_llm mode adds Gemini, Claude, OpenAI-compatible, Azure, Vertex, OpenRouter or Ollama for higher accuracy.
review.audience: Engineers converting PDFs and documents to markdown or JSON for LLM pipelines
strengths: Outputs markdown, JSON block tree with polygons, HTML or chunks, plus extracted images
Fast mode uses text layer and rf-detr layout on CPU; --disable_ocr starts no server
Batch CLI with worker pool, --skip_existing and chunk sharding across multiple machines
Reports 76.0% on olmocr-bench in balanced mode, ahead of MinerU and docling
weaknesses: Model weights use a modified OpenRAIL-M license; commercial use above startup limits needs a paid license
Balanced mode needs Docker with NVIDIA Container Toolkit, or llama.cpp on CPU and Apple Silicon
Non-PDF formats require the marker-pdf[full] extra install
README says the hosted Chandra model is more accurate than Marker
needs: Needs PyTorch, Python 3.10+, vLLM via Docker with NVIDIA Container Toolkit (GPU), llama.cpp llama-server (CPU / Apple Silicon), optional LLM service for --use_llm
Models: surya VLM, Gemini, Claude, OpenAI-compatible, Azure
